title: Lentil Curry with Saudi Arabian Spice
description: Inspired by German cuisine, this dish combines the flavors of Arabia with the comfort of a hearty lentil curry. Serve with some crusty bread or over rice for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add sliced onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add Saudi Arabian Spice Blend and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add grill-seasoned beef sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add lentils, chicken broth, tomato paste, salt, and black pepper.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
